description: This file defines an interface 'AttributeKey' which declares methods for retrieving key, value, and description attributes related to attribute keys within the domain layer of the Fineract investor module.

classes.name: AttributeKey
classes.description: An interface representing a key-value attribute with an associated description within the domain layer.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value associated with this attribute.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of this attribute.
